  PROBLEM: The close path adds the terminal `ai:closed` label before the close PATCH (comment POST at line 975, label POST at line 981, close PATCH at line 985). The new verified mode (empty fixup branch at line 964-970, call site at lines 2749-2752) now exercises this sequence.

  PROBLEM: The verified mode posts the terminal `ai:closed` label before attempting the close, so a failed close PATCH leaves the issue open but labelled `ai:closed` until the next judge run retries.
  WHY: Terminal-label consumers can treat the issue as closed until the next run heals it. Verified mitigations:

  - The retry is idempotent.
  - `reconcile_wave_issue_status` (scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:2435-2438) only gates tracked wave items, which this path excludes.
  - `check_failure_triage.sh:298` documents the open+ai:closed state.
